blocks.text: Jandaron (organisms) ki zindagi is baat ka aks hai ke un ke jism mein kya ho raha hai. Jandaron mein hone wali tamam kemiyai (chemical) sargarmiyon ka majmua, metabolism, enzymes ke zariye qaboo (regulate) hota hai.

blocks.title: Enzyme
blocks.text: Enzymes makhsoos (specific) proteins hain jo darkar activation energy ko kam kar ke makhsoos kemiyai reactions ko tez karte hain, magar is amal mein khud nahin badalte. Enzymes ko biocatalysts bhi kehte hain.

Enzyme se tez hone wale reactions ki raftar (rate) un ke bina catalyse hue reactions se 10 ki power 3 se 10 ki power 8 guna zyada ho sakti hai. Tamam cells mein enzymes ka ek jaisa majmua nahin hota: red blood cells mein hone wale kemiyai reactions nerve cell ke reactions se bohat mukhtalif hain, kyunke dono mein enzymes ke mukhtalif majmue hain.

blocks.title: Enzymes ke baghair zindagi nahin
blocks.text: Jo reaction enzyme se catalyse ho kar 30 minute mein mukammal hota hai woh enzyme ke baghair ek saal leta. Enzymes ke baghair zindagi hoti hi nahin.
Enzymes kahan bante aur kahan kaam karte hain

Tamam enzymes cells ke andar ribosomes banate hain. Banne ke baad ya to yeh cell ke andar reh kar kaam karte hain ya doosri jagahon par kaam karne ke liye bahar kharij (secreted) hote hain. Cell ke andar bohat se enzymes cytoplasm mein hal hote hain, maslan glycolysis ke enzymes. Bohat se kuch organelles ki membranes se mazbooti se jure hote hain, maslan Calvin cycle aur Krebs cycle ke enzymes. Kuch enzymes ribosomes ka lazmi hissa hain, maslan protein synthesis ke enzymes.

blocks.title: Ghalat jagah enzyme
blocks.text: Kuch enzymes ghalat jagah faal (active) ho jayen to nuqsan-deh ho sakte hain. Pepsin protein hazam karne wala enzyme hai jo un cells ke andar protein ki banawat tabah kar sakta hai jahan yeh banta hai. Isi liye yeh ghair-faal shakal (pepsinogen) mein banta hai aur cells se bahar kharij hota hai; jab yeh apni kaam ki jagah pohanchta hai to faal ho kar pepsin banta hai.

Enzymes teen-jehti (three-dimensional) globular proteins hain, jo khud par lipti polypeptide zanjeeron se bane hain. Globular enzyme molecule ki satah par ek chhota sa shigaf (cleft) ya gaddha hota hai jo sirf chand amino acids par mushtamil hai. Yeh active site hai, woh jagah jahan catalysis hoti hai. Har enzyme ke active site ki shakal bohat makhsoos hai, is liye sirf ek khaas substrate molecule us mein fit ho sakta hai; yeh teen-jehti hai aur ek makhsoos charge rakhta hai.

Active site ke do alag hisse hain, binding site aur catalytic site. Substrate molecule hydrogen bonds jaisi kamzor kemiyai quwwaton se binding site mein fit hota hai. Catalytic site reaction ko catalyse karta hai, aur substrate products mein badal jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: ek bara sabz globular enzyme jis ki satah par ek khancha (notch) hai jis mein narangi substrate fit hai; labels active site, us ke binding site aur catalytic site ki taraf hain. Daen: ek chhota enzyme jis ka site be-shakal gaddha hai; ek narangi cofactor ion aata hai aur site ek tez khancha ban jata hai jis mein substrate fit ho sakta hai.
blocks.caption: Enzyme ka active site, aur cofactor ka us ki shakal badalna (Figure 5.1 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Enzyme lipti polypeptide zanjeeron ka globular protein hai. Us ka active site chand amino acids ka chhota, teen-jehti shigaf hai jis ka makhsoos charge hai. Binding site substrate ko hydrogen bonds jaise kamzor bonds se pakarta hai; catalytic site substrate ke bonds par dabao dal kar use products mein badalta hai. Kuch enzymes ka active site tab tak ghair-faal rehta hai jab tak metal ion jaisa cofactor na jure, jo enzyme ki shakal badal kar substrate ko jurne deta hai.

blocks.caption: Active site ke hisse
rows: Hydrogen bonds jaisi kamzor quwwatein; shakal aur charge sirf ek substrate se milte hain
Substrate ko products mein badalta hai
Substrate ke khaas bonds par dabao dal kar unhen ghair-mustahkam karta hai

blocks.prompt: Proteins hazam karne wala enzyme ek aise cell ke andar mehfooz tareeqe se kyun ban sakta hai jo zyada tar proteins se bana hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh ghair-faal shakal (pepsinogen) mein banta hai jis ka active site kaam nahin karta, cell se bahar kharij hota hai, aur sirf wahan pohanch kar faal pepsin banta hai jahan us ki zaroorat hai.

items: Enzymes makhsoos proteins (biocatalysts) hain jo activation energy kam kar ke makhsoos reactions tez karte hain aur khud nahin badalte; raftar 10 ki power 3 se 10 ki power 8 guna barhti hai. Mukhtalif cells mein enzymes ke mukhtalif majmue hain.

Enzymes ribosomes banate hain; yeh cytoplasm mein (glycolysis), organelles ki membranes se jur kar (Calvin aur Krebs cycles) ya ribosomes ke hisse ke taur par kaam karte hain, ya kharij hote hain (pepsinogen se pepsin).
Active site chand amino acids ka chhota makhsoos shigaf hai: binding site jo substrate ko kamzor bonds se pakarta hai aur catalytic site jo use products mein badalta hai.
